verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own docs describe a JavaScript scenario parameter for interacting with pages before the HTML is returned. The example covers every element of the story: click (wait_for_and_click), fill input (fill) and scroll (scroll_y). The only documented limitation is that infinite_scroll is not supported with stealth_proxy. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scenarios work as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script page interactions like clicking, filling inputs, and scrolling before content is returned

citations.quote: If you want to interact with pages you want to scrape before we return your the HTML you can add JavaScript scenario to your API call.
